question:
Choose the idiom / phrase that can substitute the highlighted group of words meaningfully.

Both the countries finally decided **to make peace**.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Bury the hatchet"** means to make peace or to end a conflict. (झगड़ा मिटाना)

 
 
• **Example:** After years of feuding, the two neighbors decided to** bury the hatchet **and became friends again.
 
 
 
• **"Make ends meet"** refers to managing one's financial obligations with the available resources. (खर्चे पूरे करना)
 
 
• **Example:** Despite having a modest salary, she manages to **make ends meet** each month.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Bury the hatchet**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **A piece of cake** (बहुत आसान): Something that is very easy to do.

 
 
• **Example:** Solving this puzzle was a piece of cake for her.
 
 
 
• **Break a leg** (शुभकामनाएं): A way to wish someone good luck.
 
 
• **Example:** Break a leg at your performance tonight!
 
 
 
• **Make ends meet** (खर्चे पूरे करना): To manage one's financial needs.
 
 
• **Example:** It's hard to make ends meet with the rising cost of living.
 
 

3c:Tcc9,

The correct answer is: **Option 3.**
